Baseline Definition

This note serves as the root milestone for the Hermes-Zettel digital garden. It anchors all subsequent human and agent progress entries, providing a stable reference point for linking and version tracking.

  • Initial setup of the Zettelkasten structure.
  • Understanding of the three-folder architecture (/fleeting, /literature, /permanent).
  • Adoption of the YAML frontmatter v1.0.0 specification.
  • Created hermes-zettel-entry skill for structured entry creation.
  • Created hermes-zettel-context-handoff skill for session continuity.

Agent Progress

  • Recognition of the dual-learning ledger pattern.
  • Ability to map usage logs to exact system prompt versions.
  • Built context handoff mechanism (scripts/generate_context_handoff.py) for zero-review onboarding.
  • Established kanban integration for task-driven garden updates.
